name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
target_groups: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable landholding
summary: Central sector scheme providing income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months to all landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year transferred directly into the bank accounts of farmer families in three 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant or family must be engaged in farming/agriculture.
Applicant family must own cultivable land registered in state land revenue records.
Applicant or family member must NOT have paid income tax in the last assessment year.
Institutional landholders are excluded from the scheme.
Former or present holders of constitutional posts or government posts (Class I/II/Group A/B) are excluded.

exclusions: Institutional landholders
Farmer families holding or having held constitutional posts
Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors, District Panchayat Chairpersons
All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries and PSUs (excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees)
All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding Group D)
All persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.notes: Mandatory for Aadhaar-based authentication and DBT bank account seeding.

documents_required.name: Landholding Ownership Document / Jamabandi / RoR
documents_required.notes: Record of Rights (Khasra/Khatauni/Jamabandi) showing ownership of cultivable land in the applicant's name.

documents_required.name: Active Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar & NPCI Linked)
documents_required.notes: Bank account must be active and mapped to NPCI Aadhaar payment bridge for DBT.

documents_required.name: Active Mobile Number
documents_required.notes: Mobile number linked with Aadhaar for OTP verification and status SMS updates.

application_steps: Visit official portal https://pmkisan.gov.in and click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
Select Rural or Urban Farmer Registration, enter your Aadhaar number and mobile number, and verify OTP.
Fill state, district, sub-district, block, and village details.
Enter land record details (Survey/Khata number, Khasra number, and land area).
Upload land record certificate / Jamabandi and submit the form for state revenue verification.
Alternatively, visit your local Common Service Centre (CSC) or District Agriculture Office for assisted registration.

target_groups: Low-income, rural, and urban vulnerable families listed in SECC / NFSA / state deprivation criteria
summary: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing cashless hospital coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare.
benefits: Cashless and paperless hospitalization coverage up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled public and private hospitals nationwide, covering pre-existing conditions from day one.

eligibility_rules.description: Household income generally within economically vulnerable limits or listed in eligible SECC / NFSA category.
Beneficiary must not be covered under other statutory government health schemes like CGHS or ESIC.

exclusions: Households owning motorized 3 or 4-wheeler, fishing boat, or mechanized agricultural equipment
Households where any family member is a government employee
Households paying professional or income tax
Persons covered under CGHS, ECHS, or ESIC

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.notes: Primary identity verification document for e-KYC and Ayushman card generation.

documents_required.name: Ration Card / NFSA Card / Family ID
documents_required.notes: Used to verify family composition and linkage to eligible socio-economic database.

documents_required.name: Active Mobile Number
documents_required.notes: For OTP authentication on the Beneficiary Portal.

application_steps: Visit the official Beneficiary Portal at https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in or download the Ayushman App.

Present Ayushman Card or Aadhaar at the Ayushman Mitra desk in any empaneled hospital for cashless treatment.

target_groups: Meritorious students from economically weaker sections pursuing regular full-time college/university courses
summary: Central sector scholarship implemented by Department of Higher Education providing financial support of Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 20,000 per annum to meritorious students.
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per annum for the first three years of undergraduate studies; Rs. 20,000 per annum at the postgraduate level (or 4th/5th year of 5-year integrated courses).

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must currently be an active student enrolled in a recognized institution.
Must be pursuing a regular, full-time undergraduate or postgraduate degree course in a recognized college/university.
Total family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 4,50,000 per annum.
Students pursuing distance education, correspondence, or diploma courses without regular college degree are not eligible.
Student must not be receiving any other central or state government scholarship or fee reimbursement.

exclusions: Students pursuing correspondence, part-time, or distance education courses
Students availing benefits of any other government scholarship or stipend
Students whose gross annual family income exceeds Rs. 4.5 lakh
Students diploma holders not pursuing recognized degree courses

documents_required.notes: To verify scoring above the 80th percentile in the respective state education board examination.

documents_required.name: Family Income Certificate
documents_required.notes: Issued by a competent revenue authority (Tahsildar / SDM / Revenue Officer) certifying income under Rs. 4.50 lakh.

Log into the NSP portal with your OTR credentials and fill out the Central Sector Scholarship application form.
Upload institutional Bonafide certificate, Class 12 marksheet, and valid Income Certificate.
Submit the application and note the Application Tracking ID.
The application undergoes Level 1 Institute Verification (INO) and Level 2 State Nodal Officer (SNO) verification.
Upon merit list generation, scholarship funds are disbursed directly to the student's bank account via PFMS DBT.

Course of study must be post-matriculation (Class 11, Class 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduation, or Post-Graduation).
Combined family annual income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 per annum.

exclusions: Non-SC students or students without a valid Punjab SC caste certificate

Students pursuing a second degree at the same level in a different subject after completing one (e.g., second B.A. or second M.A.)

name: PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin)
target_groups: Houseless rural households and families living in kutcha and dilapidated houses
summary: Flagship rural housing scheme by Ministry of Rural Development providing financial grant assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh to Rs. 1.30 lakh to build permanent pucca houses with basic amenities.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs. 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/Himalayan states and UTs, paid directly into bank accounts in construction-linked milestones.
Additional 90/95 days of unskilled wage employment under MGNREGS (approx. Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 28,000 depending on state wage).
Additional Rs. 12,000 assistance for toilet construction via Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin (SBM-G).

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant household must be residing in a rural area (Gram Panchayat jurisdiction).
Applicant or family members must NOT own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Households owning motorized 2/3/4 wheelers or mechanized agricultural equipment are excluded under auto-exclusion rules.
Household with any regular government employee member is excluded.

exclusions: Families owning a pucca house in any part of the country
Households having motorized 2/3/4 wheeler or fishing boat
Households having mechanized 3/4 wheeler agricultural equipment
Households where any family member is a regular government employee
Households paying income tax or professional tax
Households owning 5 acres or more of irrigated land

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card of all family members
documents_required.notes: Mandatory for registration and geo-tagged verification.

documents_required.name: Active Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar Seeded)
documents_required.notes: Direct benefit transfer account for construction installment disbursement.

documents_required.name: MGNREGA Job Card
documents_required.notes: Required to link labor wage payments for 90/95 days of house construction.

documents_required.name: Land/Site Possession Certificate or Panchayat Declaration
documents_required.notes: Proof of ownership or legal possession of house construction plot in village.

application_steps: PMAY-G identification is carried out through the Awaas+ / SECC rural survey approved by the Gram Sabha.
Eligible rural families submit details to the Gram Panchayat Secretary or Block Development Officer (BDO).
Official enters data on the AwaasSoft portal and captures geo-tagged photographs of the existing kutcha dwelling via AwaasApp.
Gram Sabha validates priority beneficiary list; sanction order is issued by the District Collector/CEO Zila Parishad.
Funds are released in three stages (Sanction/Plinth, Lintel, and Completion) following stage-wise geo-tagged inspection.

target_groups: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work
summary: Rights-based legal guarantee providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per financial year to adult members of any rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Statutory legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per financial year per rural household at notified state wage rates.
Payment of wages within 15 days of work completion directly into worker's bank/post-office account.
Statutory unemployment allowance if employment is not provided within 15 days of written application for work.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be an adult aged 18 years or older.
Applicant must reside in a rural area within the Gram Panchayat jurisdiction.
Applicant must volunteer to perform unskilled physical/manual labor.

exclusions: Urban residents (scheme applies exclusively to rural areas)
Persons below 18 years of age
Persons unwilling to perform manual unskilled labor

documents_required.name: Proof of Age and Identity (Aadhaar Card or Voter ID)
documents_required.notes: To verify adult age (18+) and resident identity.

documents_required.name: Proof of Rural Residence (Ration Card or Gram Panchayat certificate)
documents_required.notes: To verify residence in the local Gram Panchayat.

documents_required.name: Passport Size Photographs
documents_required.notes: Photographs of all adult household members applying for the Job Card.

documents_required.name: Active Bank or Post Office Account (Aadhaar linked)
documents_required.notes: Bank/Post Office account for Aadhaar-based wage payment disbursement.

application_steps: Submit an oral or written application for Job Card registration to your local Gram Panchayat office.
Gram Panchayat verifies local residence and adult age within 15 days.
A free laminated Job Card is issued to the household containing names and photos of all adult members.
Submit a written application (Form 6) to Gram Panchayat or Programme Officer demanding work for a specified number of days.
Gram Panchayat is legally mandated to allot work within 5 km of residence within 15 days of receiving the application, else pay daily unemployment allowance.
